# Post-upgrade guards must remain rejected branches

Natural sample18 Ring3, release184, reaches22 valid native inputs and then
fails its turn4 background search. The captured Spike is calibrated at that
root. A future TitanCurse OnUnplayedNegative adds a temporary cost upgrade;
DeckSpellUpgradeModel checked only the original owner, then magic-power refresh
resolved the newly uncalibrated owner and threw, terminating both workers.

Check the changed owner before refresh and return the explicit unsupported
result. The original player failure archive reproduces the old aggregate stack.
The focused check verifies the post-upgrade rejection, a complete verified
continuation with two workers, exact prediction replay and immutable parent.
This preserves the temporary-curse coverage boundary; it does not itself claim
that the curse/triple-Juice combination has been modeled or the battle won.
